entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Charlie. I... I'm calling about an order. I bought a helmet a few weeks ago and I just... I really need to return it. I've been a loyal customer for years.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Maya Singh, order number VF88602. I just feel so bad about this. The box is completely unopened, sitting right here.

Thank you, Maya. I see the order for the Pro-Frame helmet, delivered 21 days ago. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference, I guess. I ordered it online, and the color just isn't what I thought it would be. It's a bit too bright for me. I really needed this money for something else that came up, and I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I understand completely. Sometimes colors can look different on screen. I just need to check our policy for you. One moment.
Please, I hope you can help. I picked VeloFit specifically because I trust your brand's commitment to safety, and I just want to find the right gear.

Okay, Maya, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order and our return policy. Since the helmet was delivered 21 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy with your purchase, especially when it comes to safety equipment. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That is wonderful news. You've really helped me out today. Thank you again.
My pleasure, Maya. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
